definitions.explanation: The thin, hollow needle attached to a syringe, used to inject medicine into or draw blood from the body.

examples.japanese: {注射針|ちゅうしゃばり}が{怖|こわ}い。
{看護師|かんごし}が{新|あたら}しい{注射針|ちゅうしゃばり}を{用意|ようい}した。
examples.english: The nurse prepared a new injection needle.

examples.japanese: {使|つか}い{終|お}わった{注射針|ちゅうしゃばり}は{専用|せんよう}の{容器|ようき}に{捨|す}てる。
examples.english: Used injection needles are disposed of in a dedicated container.

notes:
Compound of {注射|ちゅうしゃ} (injection) + {針|はり} (needle); はり voices to ばり in the compound. Refers to the needle component itself, as distinct from the syringe body ({注射器|ちゅうしゃき}).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {注射針|ちゅうしゃばり}を{刺|さ}す: insert the needle
- {注射針|ちゅうしゃばり}を{交換|こうかん}する: change the needle
- {使|つか}い{捨|す}ての{注射針|ちゅうしゃばり}: a disposable needle
